_comment: DEV fixture for sanctions screening. Used by src/trust/sanctions-list-loader.ts when no real sanctions feed (Chainalysis KYT / TRM Labs / Refinitiv World-Check One / Dow Jones R&C) is configured via PAYSWAP_SANCTIONS_LIST_FILE. The matcher contract is identical for both the sample list and a real feed: each entry has { list, name, entry, dob?, country? }. In production, set PAYSWAP_SANCTIONS_LIST_FILE to a path served by your compliance ops pipeline (refreshed daily from the real feed).
_warning: THIS IS A 10-NAME SAMPLE LIST — NOT A REAL SANCTIONS FEED. Do not ship to production as-is. Set PAYSWAP_SANCTIONS_LIST_FILE to a real feed file or wire src/trust/sanctions-screener.ts to a managed provider API.
